snippet.title: Isekai Emblem - Tactics in Another World
snippet.description:
Fire Emblem and anime come together as one in Isekai Emblem - Tactics in Another World! The story begins when you are hit by a truck, and reincarnate into a fantasy world as a divine dragon! It is now up to you to command an army made up of reincarnated anime characters from a wide variety of isekai franchises in this large and ambitious tactical RPG crossover!

Isekai Emblem features over a hundred characters from a wide variety of different isekai anime franchises including Sword Art Online, Re:ZERO, KonoSuba, Overlord, That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime, Shield Hero, Mushoku Tensei, and more! The game includes a quest system, where in each quest, you will experience an array of story cutscenes and tactics RPG battles. After clearing the prologue quest, the game will open up, and you will be able to play quests in any order! The game is designed primarily for mobile touchscreens, with mouse controls on the PC version.

https://hellofangaming.github.io/IsekaiEmblem/
